name: osidemedia/higgsfield-ai-prompt-skill
description: A router skill for 35 sub-skills under skills/, with a DISCIPLINE.md cross-cutting framework of 9 discipline patterns, workspace input/output/processed folders, and a learning memory and generation ledger under ~/.higgsfield-skill/db/. It routes a prompt request to the right sub-skill and prompts can be pasted into higgsfield.ai directly.
install: git clone into ~/.claude/skills/higgsfield, so Claude Code registers the root SKILL.md as one skill named higgsfield and routes to sub-skills by path; a Cowork upload route is also documented. Do not reproduce the README Higgsfield CLI pipe line; the CLI is explicitly not required for this skill to work, so use the clone route only.
